scene: The switch flips, ringing three transit gates wide open across the pavilion.
picture: A wide flat side view along the tiled Chess Pavilion floor. On the far left sits a waiting yellow monorail. The elderly man in an orange cardigan stands centrally beside the open lift with his cane. To his right waits a wooden funicular car, and on the far right waits a parked rickshaw.
shown: a sleek yellow monorail car idling at an open gate on the far left
a wooden funicular carriage waiting beside track stairs on the right
a passenger rickshaw with red lanterns parked on the far right
